testimonials.quote: I love Dr. Clifton and the staff, and they do a lot in the community.
testimonials.name: Jessica H.

testimonials.quote: When I saw Dr. Clifton she was so knowledgeable and helpful! As a medical assistant in a clinic currently, I know how much professionalism plays a big part in the medical field. The whole staff was professional and so nice! She showed she cared and didn't rush to get me out of the office like I had experienced before at other offices. They went over and beyond to help me find a good fit for frames. I definitely recommend Dr. Clifton's office to anyone ❤
testimonials.name: Heather T.

testimonials.quote: Great staff and Dr. Clifton is awesome. Our whole family goes to her for our eye care needs. She is great with my 10-years-old daughter!
testimonials.name: Andrea H.
